entry.author: New Zealand Police
entry.summary:
The New Zealand Police Air Support Unit, also referred to as Eagle, is more than just a helicopter in the sky. It's a vital part of how we keep our communities safe.
 
With a vantage point like no other, Eagle serves as an airborne observation platform. It  gives the crew a clear view of incidents as they unfold and the ability to guide officers on the ground into position for a safe and effective response.

Watch to learn more about our eyes in the sky 👀🚁
